about: Meow meow meow mes amis! Cats, kittens, kitties and other fuzzballs are hidden all around the Parisian landscape, each waiting to be found!
Take a relaxing stroll around Paris – every cat you spot brings its unique splash of colour into the scenery, and finding them all will fill the city with life!
- A huge Parisian landscape to find cats on;
- Two game modes, one harder than the other;
- Special unlockable places… filled with kittens! ^.^
- A relaxing atmosphere that anyone can enjoy!
One-time licence fee to download to multiple PS4 systems. Sign in to PlayStation is not required to use this on your primary PS4, but is required for use on other PS4 systems.
See Health Warnings for important health information before using this product.
